ns2:section.sectionText: This course provides an introduction and overview to the Arctic climate and weather systems. We will discuss the basic atmospheric heat budget, surface energy budget, atmospheric circulation and Arctic atmosphere - ocean - ice interaction. The course consists of instructor-led lectures as well as student-led discussions of peer-reviewed journal papers. Students will carry out data analysis in homework assignments to further their understanding via hands-on learning. Prerequisites: ATMS 302, ATMS 305 3 Undergraduate Credit Hours/4 Graduate Credit Hours
